title: Canonical quotient transitions under normalized K-flat counits
statement: Fix l,E,X,D as in [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower]. Let P be a K-flat complex of completed-coefficient module sheaves [def-pc-kflat-complex], M a derived object, e:Q(P)~M and n a natural number. Write c_j:Res_j(F_j(QP))->Q(Res_j(B_j tensor P)) for the universal derived scalar-extension counit followed by the exact restriction comparison [lem-weil-derived-scalar-extension-restriction-adjunction]. Let adj_m and adj_n be tensor--restriction adjunctions at m=n+1 and n whose units on QP, followed by c_m and c_n, respectively equal the localized canonical tensor units [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower]. Then the adjoint transition at M, after completed restriction and the canonical composition isomorphism, commutes with Res_j(F_j(e.inv)) followed by c_j and the localized integralTowerTransition of P. Precisely this is the equation in the attached Lean declaration; c_j is the explicitly constructed map normalizedDVRKFlatComparison, with no choice of unproved data.

proof.text: The coefficient projections commute with the quotient map. Form the finite-linear ordinary tensor quotient map b tensor x -> rho(b) tensor x. Its adjoint is the smaller tensor unit, since rho(1)=1. The pure-tensor characterization of integralTowerTransition identifies its restriction with that chain map.

proof.text: Localize the ordinary adjunction identity on P. The universal derived counits are invertible on P, and the supplied unit normalizations identify the localized adjoint with the displayed derived transition. The exact-restriction composition comparison accounts for the two ways to restrict to completed coefficients.

theorem normalizedDVR_kflat_transition
    (P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E X) ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
      (J := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
      (R := completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X) P)
    (M : completedIntegralDerivedCategory l E X D hl)
    (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ M) (n : ℕ)
    (am : scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X (n + 1) ⊣
      scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E X (n + 1))
    (an : scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n ⊣ scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E X n)
    (hm : am.unit.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
        normalizedDVRKFlatComparison l E X (n + 1) P =
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (integralTowerUnit l E X D hl P (n + 1)))
    (hn : an.unit.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
        normalizedDVRKFlatComparison l E X n P =
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (integralTowerUnit l E X D hl P n)) :
    (scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E X (n + 1)).map
        ((am.homEquiv
          M ((normalizedDVRRes l E X n.le_succ).obj
            ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n).obj M))).symm
          (an.unit.app M ≫
            (normalizedDVRResCompletedComp l E X D hl n.le_succ).inv.app
              ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n).obj M))) ≫
      (normalizedDVRResCompletedComp l E X D hl n.le_succ).hom.app
        ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n).obj M) ≫
      (scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E X n).map
        ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n).map e.inv) ≫
      normalizedDVRKFlatComparison l E X n P =
    (scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E X (n + 1)).map
        ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X (n + 1)).map e.inv) ≫
      normalizedDVRKFlatComparison l E X (n + 1) P ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (integralTowerTransition l E X D hl P n)
